title: NGEL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 147 Engineer and Executive Posts
description: The NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 147 Engineer and Executive Jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, B.Sc, Post Graduation, or Diploma can apply for the NGEL Recruitment 2026.
